notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.content:
Hello players,
We just pushed a hotfix to Snik, which addresses the following two issues;


    People unlocked 3-star achievements without actually getting three stars.
    The background music stopped in the middle of the game.


These issues are now fixed.

The Cleverweek Team
